title: Same Page · Draw it together
brief: Draw this scene together on this 400 by 400 canvas: a fox stealing a picnic in the rain. You share one goal: make it a good picture, together. You take turns and you cannot talk; the drawing is the only way to agree. Each of you must change the picture at least 3 times. You have 5 minutes. Use simple shapes (no text, letters or digits anywhere). At the end someone who knows nothing will be shown the picture and asked what it shows.

checks.say: The document is one complete SVG.
